verses.text: James, servant of God and of Lord Jesus Christ, to di 12 tribes wey scatter everywhere: Greetings.
My brothers, count am all joy when una face different kinds of test,
as una know say di testing of una faith dey produce patience.
Make patience do im perfect work, so that una go be perfect and complete, wey no lack anything.
But if any of una lack wisdom, make e ask God, wey dey give everybody well well without complain, and God go give am.
But make e ask with faith, without doubt, because person wey dey doubt dey like wave of di sea wey wind dey blow and toss.
Make dat person no think say e go receive anything from Lord.
Na person wey get two mind, wey no stable for all im ways.
But make di brother wey low rejoice for im high position,
and make di rich one rejoice say dem don make am low, because e go pass like flower for grass.
Because sun dey rise with hot wind, and e dey dry di grass; di flower fall, and di beauty of how e look perish. So di rich man go fade away for im own business.
Blessed be di man wey endure test; because when dem don approve am, e go receive di crown of life, wey Lord promise to dem wey love am.
Make nobody talk when dem dey tempt am say, “God dey tempt me,” because evil no fit tempt God, and e imself no dey tempt anybody.
But each person dey get tempted when im own desire dey pull am go and dey lure am.
Den di desire, when e don become pregnant, e go born sin. And di sin, when e don grow full, e go produce death.
My dear brothers, no make dem deceive una.
Every good gift and every perfect gift dey come from above, dey come down from di Papa of lights, wey no get change or shadow wey dey turn.
By im own will e give us new birth through di word of truth, so that we go be like di first fruits of im creatures.
So, my dear brothers, make everybody quick to hear, slow to talk and slow to vex;
because man anger no dey produce di righteousness of God.
So put away all dirty things and di plenty wickedness, and with humility receive di word wey dem plant inside una, wey fit save una souls.
But make una do di word, no be only to hear am, as una dey deceive una self.
Because if anybody dey hear di word but e no dey do am, e be like man wey dey look im own face for mirror;
because e look imself, e go, and sharp sharp e forget how im face be.
But di one wey look inside di perfect law of freedom and continue, no be hearer wey dey forget but doer wey dey work, dis man go be blessed for wetin e dey do.
If anybody among una think say e dey religious, but e no dey control im tongue and e dey deceive im heart, dis man religion no get value.
Di pure religion wey no get dirty before God wey be our Papa na dis: to visit orphans and widows for dem suffering, and to keep imself clean from di world.
My brothers, no hold di faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, di Lord of glory, with favoritism.
Because if man wey wear gold ring and fine cloth enter your synagogue, and poor man wey wear dirty cloth enter too,
and una give special attention to di one wey wear fine cloth, and talk say, “Sit here for good place”; and una tell di poor man say, “Stand dia,” or “Sit by my footstool,”
una no don show favoritism among una self, and become judges wey get evil thoughts?
Listen, my dear brothers. God no choose dem wey poor for dis world to be rich for faith and heirs of di Kingdom wey e promise to dem wey love am?
But una don dishonor di poor. Di rich people no dey oppress una and drag una go court?
Dem no dey blaspheme di honorable name wey dem call una by?
But if una obey di royal law, according to di Scripture, “Love your neighbor di same way wey you love you,” una dey do well.
But if una show favoritism, una dey sin, and di law dey show say una na lawbreakers.
Because anybody wey keep di whole law but fail for one point don become guilty of all.
Because di one wey talk say, “No commit adultery,” talk say too, “No kill.” Now if you no commit adultery but you kill, you don become lawbreaker.
So talk and so do, as people wey go face judgment by law of freedom.
Because judgment no get mercy for di one wey no show mercy. Mercy dey win judgment.
Wetin good dey, my brothers, if man talk say e get faith but e no get works? Dat faith fit save am?
If brother or sister no get cloth and no get daily food,
and one of una tell dem say, “Go for peace, make una dey warm and chop full,” but una no give dem wetin di body need, wetin good dey?
Na so too faith, if e no get works, e don die by imself.
Yes, somebody go talk say, “You get faith, and I get works.” Show me your faith without works, and I go show you my faith by my works.
You believe say God na one. You do well. Di demons believe am too, and dem dey shake.
But you want know, foolish man, say faith without works dey dead?
No be by works dem make Abraham our forefather righteous, as e offer im pikin Isaac for di altar?
You see say faith dey work together with im works, and by works faith become perfect;
and di Scripture wey talk say, “Abraham believe God, and dem count am for am as righteousness,” come true. Dem call am God friend.
So you see say by works dem dey make man righteous, no be by faith only.
Na so too, no be by works dem make Rahab di prostitute righteous, as e receive di messengers and send dem go another way?
Because as di body without spirit dey dead, na so faith without works dey dead.
My brothers, make plenty of una no become teachers, because we know say we go receive heavier judgment.
Because we all dey fail for many ways. If anybody no fail for word, dat one na perfect man, wey fit control di whole body too.
If we put bit for horse mouth so that dem go obey us, we dey guide dem whole body too.
Look, even ships, even though dem big and strong winds dey drive dem, one very small rudder dey guide dem go wherever di pilot want.
Na so di tongue too na small part of di body, but e dey boast big things. See how small fire fit burn big forest!
Di tongue na fire. Di tongue na world of wickedness among our body parts, wey dey make di whole body dirty, e dey set di course of life for fire, and Gehenna dey set am for fire.
Because every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing and sea creature, people fit tame am, and people don tame dem,
but nobody fit tame di tongue. Na restless evil, e full of deadly poison.
With am we dey bless our Lord and Papa; and with am we dey curse men, wey dem make for God image.
From di same mouth blessing and curse dey come. My brothers, dese things no suppose be so.
Spring dey send out fresh water and bitter water from di same hole?
My brothers, fig tree fit produce olives, or vine produce figs? So no spring fit give both salt water and fresh water.
Who wise and get understanding among una? Make e show am by im good way of life say im deeds dey come from di gentleness of wisdom.
But if una get bitter jealousy and selfish ambition inside una heart, no boast and no lie against di truth.
Dis kind wisdom no be di one wey dey come from above, but na earthly, of flesh, and demonic.
Because wia jealousy and selfish ambition dey, confusion dey and every evil deed dey.
But di wisdom wey come from above first na pure, den peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without favoritism and without hypocrisy.
Now dem dey plant di fruit of righteousness for peace, for dem wey dey make peace.
Wia di wars and fights among una dey come from? No be from una pleasures wey dey fight inside una body?
Una want, but una no get. Una kill and envy, but una no fit get. Una dey fight and make war. Una no get, because una no ask.
Una ask, but una no receive, because una dey ask with wrong reason, so that una go spend am for una pleasures.
Una wey dey commit adultery, una no know say friendship with di world na enmity against God? So anybody wey want be friend of di world dey make imself enemy of God.
Or una think say di Scripture dey talk for nothing, say, “Di Spirit wey dey stay inside us dey long with jealous love”?
But e dey give more grace. So e talk say, “God dey resist di proud, but e dey give grace to di humble.”
So submit to God. Resist di devil, and e go run comot from una.
Come near God, and e go come near una. Wash una hands, una sinners; and make una heart clean, una wey get two mind.
Cry, mourn and weep. Make una laugh turn to mourning, and una joy turn to sorrow.
Make una humble before Lord, and e go lift una up.

No talk against each other, brothers. Di one wey dey talk against im brother, or dey judge im brother, dey talk against di law and dey judge di law. But if you judge di law, you no be doer of di law, but judge.
Only one dey wey give di law, wey fit save and wey fit destroy. But who you be to judge another person?
Come now, una wey dey talk say, “Today or tomorrow make we go dis city, stay there for one year, do business and make profit.”
Una no even know how una life go be tomorrow. Because wetin be una life? Una na vapor wey show for small time and den e disappear.
Instead una suppose talk say, “If Lord want am, we go live and do dis one or dat one.”
But now una dey glory for una boasting. All dis kind boasting na evil.
So person wey know to do good but e no do am, e don sin.
Come now, una wey rich, make una weep and cry loud for di miseries wey dey come on una.
Una riches don spoil and moth don eat una cloth.
Una gold and una silver don rust, and dem rust go testify against una, and e go eat una flesh like fire. Una don keep treasure for di last days.
Look, di pay of di workers wey cut una farm, wey una cheat dem and hold back, dey cry out; and di cry of dem wey harvest don enter di ears of di Lord of Armies.
Una don live for luxury for earth and enjoy pleasure. Una don feed una heart for day of slaughter.
Una don condemn and kill di righteous one. E no dey resist una.
So be patient, brothers, until Lord come. Look, di farmer dey wait for di precious fruit of di earth, dey patient for am, until e receive di early and late rain.
Una too, be patient. Make una heart strong, because Lord coming don near.
No complain against each other, brothers, so that dem no go judge una. Look, di judge dey stand for di door.
Brothers, take di prophets wey talk for di name of Lord as example of suffering and of patience.
Look, we dey call dem blessed wey endure. Una don hear about Job patience, and una don see wetin Lord do for di end, say Lord full of compassion and mercy.
But above all things, my brothers, no swear, no be by heaven, or by earth, or by any other oath; but make una “yes” be “yes,” and una “no” be “no,” so that una no go fall under judgment.
Anybody among una dey suffer? Make e pray. Anybody dey happy? Make e sing praises.
Anybody among una dey sick? Make e call di elders of di church, and make dem pray over am, as dem dey anoint am with oil for di name of Lord.
Di prayer of faith go heal di one wey dey sick, and Lord go raise am up. If e don commit sins, dem go forgive am.
So confess una wrongs to each other, and pray for each other, so that una go heal. Di serious prayer of righteous person get power well well.
Elijah na man wey get nature like us, and e pray hard make rain no fall; and rain no fall for di earth for three years and six months.
E pray again; and di sky give rain, and di earth bring out im fruit.
Brothers, if any among una wander comot from di truth, and somebody bring am back,
make e know say di one wey bring sinner back from di error of im way go save im soul from death, and e go cover plenty sins.
